extracted.intended_audience: USPTO staff, policymakers, patent practitioners, and researchers analyzing patent office operations
extracted.subtask_description: A set of operational metrics and definitions used by the USPTO to report on examiner staffing, hiring/attrition, examination time, inventory, and pendency for UPR (utility, plant, reissue) patent applications. Intended to track workforce and processing performance over fiscal years.

rubrics_metrics.name: UPR Examiner Staff
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of patent examiners at the USPTO, not including design patent examiners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Counts the active examiner workforce for utility, plant, and reissue (UPR) patent examination; used as the numerator/base for other staffing and productivity metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner Hires
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of UPR examiner hires completed within the fiscal year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Annual count of new examiners added during the fiscal year; used in conjunction with attrition to assess staffing changes and first-year attrition rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner Attritions
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of UPR examiners that left, either voluntarily or involuntarily.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Annual count of examiners separating from UPR staff; can be broken down by grade/role (e.g., junior vs primary) and is used to calculate net staffing change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Junior Examiner (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: A patent examiner who is not authorized to legally approve office actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Role classification used to distinguish attrition and staffing metrics; typically lower-graded examiners who require review/oversight on office actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary Examiner (definition)
rubrics_metrics.description: A patent examiner authorized to legally approve office actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Role classification indicating an examiner with authority to sign/approve office actions; used for breakdowns of attrition and staffing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual Attrition — Junior Examiner Attritions
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual count of attritions among junior examiners (those not authorized to legally approve office actions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented alongside primary examiner attritions to show workforce turnover by authorization status; helps identify whether turnover is concentrated among less-experienced staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual Attrition — Primary Examiner Attritions
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual count of attritions among primary examiners (those authorized to legally approve office actions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Important for assessing loss of experienced examiners and potential impacts on examination capacity and quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: First Year Attritions
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of examiners hired in a fiscal year who left within their first year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown as both counts and a percentage 'First Year Attrition Rate'. Note: FY2024 first year attrition rate is omitted since employees hired in FY2024 are still within their first year.

rubrics_metrics.name: First Year Attrition Rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage of examiners hired in a fiscal year who attrited within their first year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calculated as first-year attritions divided by hires for that fiscal year; used to monitor early retention of new hires and onboarding effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination Time
rubrics_metrics.description: The time a patent examiner spends examining patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Breaks down total work time into Examination, Leave, and Other Time. 'Leave' includes all types of leave (sick, annual, holiday). 'Other time' includes training, staff meetings, and time associated with various initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination Time Components — Leave
rubrics_metrics.description: Portion of examiner time categorized as leave (sick, annual, holiday).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used in the time-use breakdown to explain non-examination portions of examiner capacity; impacts available examination time and throughput.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination Time Components — Other Time
rubrics_metrics.description: Portion of examiner time spent on activities other than direct examination or leave, including training, staff meetings, and initiative-related work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes non-examination duties that reduce time available for examining applications; relevant when assessing productivity and required staffing levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hours per Production Unit (Examination Time per Case)
rubrics_metrics.description: The average number of examining hours taken by an examiner to examine an application from start to finish (hours per production unit), reported by grade (GS-7 through GS-15).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lower-graded examiners are allotted more time per application than higher-graded examiners. Used to compute expected throughput and to compare productivity across grades and years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unexamined Inventory (UPR)
rubrics_metrics.description: The unexamined patent application inventory is the number of new utility, plant, and reissue (UPR) patent applications in the pipeline at any given time which are awaiting a First Office Action by the patent examiner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key backlog indicator for new (serialized) applications awaiting first action; excludes RCEs and other non-UPR categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Serialized Filings
rubrics_metrics.description: Serialized filings: new cases filed (serialized) as distinct from RCE filings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Counts of serialized filings are used when measuring the inflow of new UPR work; important for distinguishing new-work inventory from continuation/RCE workload.

rubrics_metrics.name: Serialized First Actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Serialized first actions: first actions taken on new (serialized) cases, distinct from RCE actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tracks throughput on new-application work; comparing serialized first actions to serialized filings and unexamined inventory indicates whether backlog is growing or shrinking.

rubrics_metrics.name: First Action Pendency
rubrics_metrics.description: Time until a first action by the USPTO; includes the time until a first office action and any time awaiting a reply from an applicant to submit all parts of their application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported in months. Used to measure speed of initial examination response and access to examination resources for new filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Pendency
rubrics_metrics.description: Time from the patent application filing date to the date the application has reached final disposition (e.g., issued as a patent or abandoned), called a 'disposal'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported in months. Indicates overall time applicants wait for final resolution and captures all cycles of prosecution, appeals, and applicant responses.
